answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake. A fake docked at the harbor must still fund its own bond, clear as crystal and just as losable, and one caught clone forfeits the whole deposit like spilled nectar. A swarm now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade, not a free registration.
